title: configure-module input
description: Configure the RustDesk server and its web console

host.description: Fully qualified domain name of the web console

rustdesk_host.description: Host name or IP address that RustDesk clients use for the ID and relay servers. Defaults to host

lets_encrypt.description: Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for the web console

web_client.description: Enable the browser client and open the websocket ports 21118 and 21119

ban_threshold.description: Failed logins within 5 minutes after which the client IP is blocked for 30 minutes. 0 disables the block

log_retention_days.description: Days to keep login, connection and file transfer logs. 0 keeps them forever

admin_allowlist.description: IP addresses or CIDR networks allowed to open the web console. Empty allows everyone
